intro: An addictive Lingo-style word puzzle! Play through the map or start a streak!
description:
Welcome to the ultimate word puzzle experience designed for brain trainers and language lovers alike! Inspired by traditional Lingo-style word games, this title challenges you to guess hidden words under time pressure using strategic color-coded clues.

Green means the letter is correct and in the perfect spot; yellow means the letter is in the word but in the wrong position. Use your logic, unlock power-ups, and climb the scoreboard!

Key Features:
Thrilling Streak Mode: Put your skills to the ultimate test! Face an endless barrage of words back-to-back. With shifting word lengths and randomized themes, how many words can you solve in a row before breaking the chain?

Diverse Word Lengths: Play through dynamic modes featuring 4-letter, 5-letter, and 6-letter words to steadily increase the challenge.

Rich Category Map: Explore an interactive progression map. Test your vocabulary across dedicated categories including General Knowledge, Science, Art, Verbal, Literature, Architecture, and Psychology.

Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tough word? Use your hard-earned coins to activate powerful power-ups like the Bomb (to eliminate wrong letters) or Time Extenders to keep the clock ticking.

Engaging Progression: Earn score multipliers, collect thousands of coins, and clear stages with a perfect 3-star rating to prove your word mastery.

Full Nintendo Switch™ Support: Play comfortably on the big screen in TV Mode, on your tabletop, or on the go with full Handheld Mode optimization.

Whether you want a quick 5-minute mental workout, a deep dive into advanced vocabulary, or a high-stakes run in Streak Mode, this game offers endless hours of educational and addictive puzzle fun. Sharpen your wits, expand your vocabulary, and become the ultimate word champion today!
